subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term. 

PRACTISE : ACEIPRST :: TECHNOLOGY : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73e690c12a66adaf209adf0b1ff008bb704c48783bd537b818e9d442fb16b230.png] 

The logic followed here is: **Alphabet are arranged according alphabet series.**

 
• PRACTISE
 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: A > C> E > I > P > R > S > T
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24fd1a3ccdafc16fcd103efc812d32119fd1269fd935160954013be94f800fa2.png] 
 
 

Similarly,

 
• TECHNOLOGY
 
 
• Alphabetical order of letters: C > E > G > H > L > N > O > O > T > Y 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d004849749c4a917df138b8d1d5ac40ddd4dc4f7066b5689ad4526a47ec99329.png] 
 
 

Hence, '**CEGHLNOOTY**' is the correct answer.
